title: Causal Risk-Envelope Caching for Fast-WAM Optional-IDM
hook: At the same cache-skip rate, units with similar hidden-state change can have very different paired action/video error because a small high-risk tail carries most of the downstream influence; a causal risk envelope should therefore refresh that tail and reuse the bulk. The predicted direction is lower paired downstream error than periodic or local-drift gating at matched skip rate while preserving closed-loop task success.
hook_shape_rationale: This is the surprising-empirical-reveal shape: the admission test is a named paired downstream discrepancy and a pre-registered tail-versus-homogeneous-null comparison, neither of which is established by C3ache or the WorldCache variants. A structural-reframe hook was viable, but it would merely rename cache validity; the candidate instead requires the risk distribution to be causally measured and to change the downstream decision.

gap_closure.gap: No retrieved frontier leaf establishes an output-preserving validity condition for reusing intermediate representations after a changed receding observation: C3ache reuses residuals on a fixed cross-chunk cadence, while the action and predicted-video consequences of a stale residual are not jointly bounded — stakes: a closed-loop robot can issue stale actions after contact or motion changes, wasting expensive rollouts or causing task failure; intellectually, reported cache speedups cannot be transferred to WAM-Optional-IDM control without knowing when the approximation becomes invalid.
gap_closure.how_closed: C00 reframes cache validity as a causal per-unit downstream-risk envelope and a constrained reuse-selection object, while the architectural companion consumes that object as a risk-budgeted selective-refresh operator with explicit descendant invalidation.

core_mechanism: For each cached Fast-WAM unit u=(b,k), where b is a denoising block and k is its denoising step, stale-value replay on a non-empty calibration trace i produces full outputs y_i^a,y_i^v and stale outputs y_{i,u}^a,y_{i,u}^v, from which D^a_{i,u}=||y_{i,u}^a-y_i^a||_2^2/(||y_i^a||_2^2+eta) and D^v_{i,u}=||y_{i,u}^v-y_i^v||_2^2/(||y_i^v||_2^2+eta) are computed. The central object is a monotone q_conf upper risk envelope r_u(d) of D_joint=lambda_a D^a+lambda_v D^v against d, where d=||h_{u,t}-h_{u,s}||_2/(||h_{u,s}||_2+eta) compares the current and cached source tensors produced by the unchanged prefix, eta is the positive machine-precision floor of the active dtype, and lambda_a=lambda_v=1 are fixed equal weights. For every unit, A_u is the calibration mean of r_u(d) over that unit's observed d values; the method must report the full A_u distribution, its upper-tail mass at alpha_tail, and a label-permutation null that equalizes unit identities before claiming influence heterogeneity. If the pre-registered p_hetero test does not reject the homogeneous null, the method falls back to a pooled envelope and makes no heterogeneity claim rather than tuning a partition into existence. At a changed receding observation, the operator computes d_u for each candidate unit and solves a risk-budgeted selection that maximizes saved measured block time subject to the sum of selected r_u(d_u) staying below epsilon_joint, while forcing the highest-risk alpha_tail units to refresh and rejecting entries past H_max or with a changed Optional-IDM mode. A refreshed upstream unit marks every dependent cache unit dirty and forces topological recomputation before either final branch is read, so the cached action-conditioned suffix cannot inherit a stale residual chain. The causal controls hold this same selective-refresh operator fixed: an exchangeable homogeneous calibration table tests operator-only speed/fidelity, while real heterogeneous traces compare unit-specific envelopes with a pooled envelope at matched risk and skip rate to isolate the risk-allocation effect. This mechanism operates across receding observations and keeps action-conditioned computation in the Fast-WAM Optional-IDM graph; it does not factor an action-independent prefix across CEM candidates or make a planner-order certificate of the DINO-WM RankSafe Prefix Cache family. Operational definitions fixed before held-out evaluation: alpha_tail=0.10; the tail contains exactly ceil(alpha_tail times the number of units) units, ordered by descending A_u with a stable unit-ID tie break; T_hetero is the mean A_u in that tail minus the mean over all units; each permutation independently permutes complete unit labels within every calibration transition, preserving each transition's full tuple set and per-unit tuple counts, refits r_u and A_u, and uses B_perm=10000 Monte Carlo permutations with the add-one p-value (exact enumeration is allowed for a tractable finite probe); if fewer than two units have calibration tuples, the pooled fallback is mandatory and no heterogeneity claim is made.
core_mechanism_reasoning:
BLOCK 1 — PREMISES ledger:
P1. A stale Fast-WAM unit can affect both Optional-IDM outputs through the shared denoising dependency graph; this follows from the validated video-then-action computation path and is checked by the stale-value replay.
P2. The conditional relation between current source change d and paired downstream discrepancy is stable enough from calibration to held-out receding transitions for an upper envelope to rank refresh risk; untested — falsification target.
P3. Unit-level downstream risk is heterogeneous rather than exchangeable, with a high-risk tail that can dominate paired error; untested — falsification target and tested against a unit-label permutation null.
P4. Full-vector source change is a more faithful observable than mean pooling for this gate because equal-and-opposite coordinates are not discarded by the norm; untested — falsification target, not a guarantee.
P5. The traced dependency graph is complete, so topological dirty propagation reaches every descendant before either output is consumed; untested — falsification target.
OBSERVATION-MODEL: calibration and held-out inputs are policy-selected receding robot observations from existing LIBERO and RoboTwin rollouts, including nominal and contact or motion-change transitions; they are not IID and no unbiased-sampling claim is made.
ESTIMAND: the held-out expectation of D_joint=lambda_a D^a+lambda_v D^v per receding-observation transition under the selected reuse set, where D^a and D^v are squared-error discrepancies relative to uncached Optional-IDM action vectors and predicted-observation clips; A_u is the calibration mean of the envelope r_u(d) for unit u.
The design avoids the method-lineage regression to local denoising dynamics as a sufficient validity proxy, and its cached object is not the action-independent shared prefix used by the sibling DINO-WM RankSafe candidate.
BLOCK 2 — NAIVE-BASELINE AUDIT: the naive version uses a periodic C3ache-style schedule or one global local-drift threshold to reuse every eligible unit. It fails under branch (i): the naive version silently assumes that the same observed feature change has the same downstream consequence for every unit and that action and predicted-observation branches share one sensitivity, while the unit-risk tail and paired stale-value interventions can falsify both premises. The proposed mechanism confronts that failure with a causal leave-one-unit-out envelope, a homogeneous-null test, a risk budget, and dependency-complete refresh; the domain-specific structure that makes this more than a textbook quantile gate is the shared Fast-WAM Optional-IDM graph with policy-selected receding observations and two coupled downstream outputs, under a no-retraining constraint.
BLOCK 3 — DESIGN RATIONALE: the anchor is kept single-gap because the risk object, its causal validation, and the selective-refresh operator are one chain; the other gaps are evaluation properties already enforced by D_joint and the controls. The earlier scalar influence-times-mean-drift design was rejected because it could not establish a non-exchangeable influence distribution and its mean statistic admits cancellation; a learned cache policy was rejected because it adds training and hides the causal risk object. The factorial controls deliberately separate operator-only speed/fidelity from unit-specific risk allocation, and the candidate is accepted only if those downstream controls support the claimed mechanism rather than merely reporting a global mean improvement.
core_mechanism_steps:
1. Freeze the existing Fast-WAM checkpoint and validated Optional-IDM path, then construct non-empty calibration and held-out splits from LIBERO and RoboTwin receding-observation rollouts; record each cache unit u=(b,k), source tensor h_{u,s}, current tensor h_{u,t}, action vector, predicted-observation clip, dependency edges, and native GPU timing.
2. For every calibration transition and unit, replay the graph once with only u replaced by its stale cached value, keeping all other inputs fixed; compute D^a and D^v against the uncached outputs with eta as the active-dtype floor and lambda_a=lambda_v=1, and store (d_{i,u},D_joint_{i,u}) without fitting on held-out outcomes.
3. For each u, sort its observed d values, compute the q_conf empirical upper quantile of D_joint at each cumulative d knot, and take the cumulative maximum to obtain the monotone envelope r_u(d); q_conf=0.95 is fixed before held-out evaluation, and d values beyond the observed calibration range force a fresh computation instead of extrapolation.
4. Compute A_u as the mean of r_u(d_{i,u}) over calibration transitions, report its empirical survival curve and alpha_tail mass, and run a unit-label permutation test that pools the same trace-level tuples while destroying unit identity; p_hetero=0.05 is the pre-registered decision level, and failure to reject activates the pooled-envelope fallback.
5. In each new receding-observation inference, run the unchanged prefix to form h_{u,t}, compute the full-vector d_u against h_{u,s}, look up r_u(d_u), and set the reuse variable x_u=1 only for units whose mode matches and age is at most H_max; H_max is the largest observed age whose held-out envelope discrepancy satisfies epsilon_joint, with one receding interval as the default when no larger age is supported.
6. Select the eligible x_u values by maximizing measured saved block time subject to sum_u x_u r_u(d_u) <= epsilon_joint, with epsilon_joint=0.01 fixed before held-out evaluation, while forcing the units in the upper alpha_tail risk set to x_u=0; use the same rule for every inference and never tune it from task success.
7. For each x_u=0 unit, recompute from the current observation and replace its cached tensor and source fingerprint; mark every downstream dependent unit dirty and recompute all dirty descendants in topological order before either the final action or predicted-observation output is consumed.
8. Run the causal control matrix on the same held-out traces: uncached full computation, periodic C3ache-style reuse, one global local-drift gate, the full risk-envelope operator, the operator-only homogeneous-control table with the same operator, and a heterogeneous real-trace arm that swaps the unit-specific envelopes for the pooled envelope at matched skip rate.
9. On a minimum 2-A100 campaign, record native GPU event latency including lookup and fallback, saved block time, tail-mass versus the homogeneous null, branch-normalized and raw action MSE, predicted-observation MSE, and closed-loop task success; report the operator effect on homogeneous controls separately from the unit-risk allocation effect on heterogeneous traces. For deterministic execution, the empirical q_conf quantile at a cumulative knot with m values is the order statistic at rank ceil(q_conf*m), and r_u(d) is a right-continuous step envelope using the largest calibration knot d_j<=d; d below the smallest knot or above the largest knot forces a fresh computation, and all risk constraints say 'at most epsilon_joint'. H_max is selected only from calibration tuples as the largest supported age whose maximum applicable envelope discrepancy is at most epsilon_joint, defaulting to one receding interval when none is supported; candidate units without a calibration tuple are always refreshed until calibrated. Step 8 additionally computes and reports per-held-out-transition D_joint and its mean, matching the declared estimand, and the high-risk tail uses the same stable tie rule.
falsification_prediction: Run the existing Fast-WAM Optional-IDM checkpoint on held-out LIBERO and RoboTwin receding-observation rollouts, comparing uncached inference, periodic C3ache-style reuse, a global local-drift gate, and the proposed risk-envelope operator at matched skip rates with native GPU timing. If the mechanism is correct, the per-unit envelope r_u(d) will show a non-exchangeable high-risk tail relative to the unit-label permutation null, and the proposed operator will reduce held-out D_joint, action MSE, and predicted-observation MSE relative to the global gate without lowering closed-loop task success. The single load-bearing variable is the unit-specific risk envelope r_u(d); a negative control permutes complete envelopes across cache units while preserving the risk budget, skip rate, and dependency logic, and should increase downstream D_joint and reduce task success rather than merely changing the envelope values. If the heterogeneity test fails or the envelope permutation leaves downstream outcomes unchanged, the claimed causal risk-allocation mechanism is falsified even if a latency reduction remains.
compute_budget: Minimum campaign: 2 A100 GPUs, expandable to 4 for parallel matched arms; approximately 12 A100-GPU-days for calibration replays, native latency profiling, homogeneous/null controls, and held-out LIBERO/RoboTwin evaluation using the existing checkpoint, with no full pretraining; $0 API because all inference and evaluation are local.

differentiation_from_lit.delta: C3ache reuses same-denoising-step action-expert residuals on a periodic cross-chunk cadence, whereas this candidate causally estimates a unit-specific paired-output risk envelope, protects its empirically tested high-risk tail, and allocates reuse under a downstream error budget with dependency-complete refresh.

EfficientVLA caches attention and MLP intermediates within a CogACT action head from feature similarity, whereas this candidate uses stale-value interventions on Fast-WAM Optional-IDM to estimate receding-observation risk jointly for action and predicted-observation outputs without retraining.

The heterogeneous-token WorldCache uses curvature and accumulated drift to preserve video rollout quality, whereas this candidate's load-bearing object is an empirically calibrated paired action/video downstream-risk envelope whose tail is tested against a homogeneous null and a unit-permutation control.

X-Cache gates autoregressive video-block reuse with structure- and action-aware input fingerprints and KV-update guards, whereas this candidate refreshes Fast-WAM Optional-IDM units from a constrained paired-output error budget and validates the action branch and predicted-observation branch together after receding changes.

OnlineCache learns a policy and an error corrector for diffusion caching, whereas this candidate remains training-free and makes the causal stale-value risk envelope, its heterogeneity null, and its dependency refresh rule the directly testable mechanism.

DriveCache already combines a planned-motion, scene-level dynamic-programming schedule with a calibrated response budget and causal drift-triggered refresh/replan; this candidate instead contributes a per-unit stale-value intervention with a paired action/video downstream-risk envelope, a unit-label heterogeneity test, and dependency-complete descendant invalidation, so action-aware budgeted refresh alone is not claimed as novel.

what_step_was_missed: C3ache would have needed to replay each cached block-timestep with a stale value while holding the remaining Fast-WAM Optional-IDM graph fixed, estimate a per-unit paired action/predicted-observation risk envelope conditioned on the changed receding observation, test whether its risk distribution is genuinely heterogeneous, and solve a downstream error-budgeted refresh problem with descendant recomputation; its fixed cadence and task-success aggregate do not construct any of these causal validity objects.
